context:
Extract-method is the primary tool. For each hotspot:
  1. Read the function; identify cohesive branches (often one per phase,
     subcommand, or resource category).
  2. Extract each branch to a private helper with a clear single
     responsibility.
  3. Re-run the full fast test suite per commit.
  4. Confirm `ruff check --select=C901 <file>` is clean for that file
     before moving on.

For cli/commands/run.py::run specifically, the 285 score indicates it is
effectively a dispatcher. Extract by phase (generate/load/power/throughput/
maintenance), by platform-option parsing, and by result finalization; the
click decorator surface stays on the outer `run` shell.

Prefer small, reviewable PRs - one commit per hotspot at minimum. Do not
bundle refactors across modules.
description:
Quality plan supplement - complexity workstream. The ratchet target is
McCabe **18** (aligning with `quality-bulk-fix-encoding-lint-and-ratchet`).
As of 2026-04-13, 7 C901 violations remain above threshold 18 after an
ongoing refactor campaign brought the count down from 44+. The worst
remaining offender - `cli/commands/run.py::run` at McCabe 285 - is an
unmanaged dispatcher that must be split into phase/option/result helpers.

Bring every function under 18, then add C901 to the permanent ruff `select`
with `max-complexity=18` so regression is impossible. Sequence big-blast-
radius offenders into their own slices; bulk the long tail by module.

Remaining offenders above threshold 18 (as of 2026-04-13):
  cli/commands/run.py::run                                     285
  platforms/dataframe/unified_frame.py::_datafusion_join_with_exprs  23
  core/tpcds/benchmark/runner.py::run_throughput_test           22
  core/tpcds/benchmark/runner.py::run_power_test                22
  platforms/databricks/adapter.py::_upload_to_uc_volume         21
  platforms/databricks/adapter.py::apply_table_tunings          21
  platforms/dataframe/unified_frame.py::_extract_multi_agg_arithmetic  21

anti_patterns.dont: add `# noqa: C901` to silence violations
bundle multiple hotspot refactors into one commit
change public API surface during extraction
introduce new abstractions just to hit the number
anti_patterns.instead: extract only cohesive helpers that tell a story

preserves.behavior: All existing tests pass after every slice (≥21,000 tests)
No new `# noqa: C901` suppressions - refactor, don't silence (exception: generated code or vendored shims with inline rationale)
Public CLI surface of `benchbox run` unchanged (same options, same exit codes, same help text)
Runtime behavior of every refactored function - this is structural extraction, not behavior change

scope_rules.path_glob: adapter implementation files not in the inventory
functions listed in the C901 inventory

verifications.expected: matches pre-refactor hash captured at start of w1

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import tomllib; cfg = tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb')); assert 'C901' in cfg['tool']['ruff']['lint']['select']"

work_units.summary: Refactor cli/commands/run.py::run (285→<18): extract option-resolution, phase-selection, platform-dispatch, and result-reporting helpers. Own commit. Validate CLI help/behavior unchanged.
Clear remaining 6 M19-M23 hotspots one-per-commit: _datafusion_join_with_exprs, run_throughput_test, run_power_test, _upload_to_uc_volume, apply_table_tunings, _extract_multi_agg_arithmetic
Remove C901 from [tool.ruff.lint.ignore] in pyproject.toml (C90 already in select). Confirm `uv run ruff check .` returns 0 C901 errors.
CI gate is already covered by existing `uv run ruff check .` in lint.yml - no separate step needed since C901 is now in active select.
